name: Amelia Brooks
source: Amelia is one of the members of Squad Zero, an elite assassin squad under the Zero Program, an assassin branch inside of the secret agent organization Adelcorp. After experiencing a shaky upbringing with her family of secret agents constantly being in the crosshairs of espionage and sabotage conflicts, Amelia's trust in people outside of her squad are minute.
